semantics.empty_or_incomplete_global_evaluation: no best selection or patience consumption
semantics.exact_success_count: native private integer receipt; public JSON fields unchanged
semantics.selection: globally identical metrics/best/patience and collective best publication; failed save restores prior selection
semantics.inference: unwrapped local policy; buffer broadcast preference honored once; local buffers, RNGs, module modes and pending gradients preserved
semantics.cleanup_failure: buffer restoration failure poisons training/evaluation until successful native checkpoint reload

boundaries: Every live native DDP participant enters evaluation. Scenario inputs are local partitions; counts report attempts, not deduplicated unique cases. Collective timeout must cover slowest partition. Serialize with training and other process-global RNG consumers. Arbitrary callback/remote-service collectives, process failure recovery and environment-owned RNG/state are outside this protocol.
count_note: Overlapping targeted source/wheel tests. Six actual distributed pytest contracts contain many scenarios; 28 evaluation scenarios per peer are not separate pytest cases.
